panels.alt: MX Modular input 9-16 and digital master section

items.name: Stereo pair on
items.label: ON
items.text: Each stereo pair (9/10, 11/12, 13/14, 15/16) has an On Button that activates or mutes its routing into the master bus.

items.name: Stereo pair level
items.label: LEVEL
items.text: Adjusts the volume of each stereo pair before it is summed into the master bus.

items.name: AUX 1 to USB
items.label: AUX 1 TO USB · SEND / RETURN
items.text: Button 1 routes AUX 1 to USB inputs 9/10; button 2 picks the dry send or the processed return.

items.name: AUX 2 to USB
items.label: AUX 2 TO USB · SEND / RETURN
items.text: Button 1 routes AUX 2 to USB inputs 11/12; button 2 picks the dry send or the processed return.

items.name: BUS 1 to USB
items.label: BUS 1 TO USB · SEND / RETURN
items.text: Button 1 routes BUS 1 to USB inputs 13/14; button 2 picks the dry send or the processed return.

items.name: BUS 2 to USB
items.label: BUS 2 TO USB · SEND / RETURN
items.text: Button 1 routes BUS 2 to USB inputs 15/16; button 2 picks the dry send or the processed return.

items.name: Digital master on
items.label: MASTER ON
items.text: With its knob, mixes the Stereo Master L and R from the USB interface into the analog summing bus.

items.name: Digital master level
items.label: LEVEL
items.text: Mixes the USB digital master return with the analog summing bus.

items.name: Input source 9-16
items.label: 9-16 AG / 9-16 USB
items.text: Chooses whether channels 9–16 come from the analog inputs on the back panel or from USB channels 9–16.

ref.strong: Button 1: Input Source Selection for Channels 9–16

items.name: USB return solo
items.label: USB RET SOLO
items.text: Routes only the USB digital master return to the summing bus; other channels are muted, AUX and BUS sends stay active.
